import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Metrics, Model, Supply, DataOf, StateOf } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as jsonl from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import * as qdrant from 'harness-dsl/qdrant';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const Topic = H.kind('Topic').data(z.object({
  title: z.string(),
  question: z.string(),
  tags: z.array(z.string()),
})).states({
  queued: 'pending',
  researching: 'active',
  delivered: 'succeeded',
  failed: 'failed',
  parked: 'ended',
  cancelled: 'cancelled',
}, 'queued');

type TopicSupply = Supply<DataOf<typeof Topic>, StateOf<typeof Topic>>;

const Findings = H.memory('report-findings', 'fallible');
const SourceExperience = H.memory('source-experience', 'fallible');

const nearestFindings = H.policy.recall('nearest-findings', view =>
  [...view.items]
    .filter(item => (item.similarity ?? 0) >= 0.7)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.similarity ?? 0) - (a.similarity ?? 0) || b.specificity - a.specificity)
    .slice(0, 8));

const findings = H.library('findings', Findings, qdrant.memory({
  url: 'https://vectors.example.com',
  collection: 'findings',
  embedder: 'text-embedding-small',
  apiKey: H.env('QDRANT_API_KEY'),
})).recall(nearestFindings);
const sourceExperience = H.library('source-experience', SourceExperience, jsonl.memory('memory/sources.jsonl'));

const haiku = anthropic.model('claude-haiku');
const opus = anthropic.model('claude-opus');
const sonnet = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet');

const source = z.object({ url: z.string(), claim: z.string() });

const searcherRole = H.role('search-and-extract')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string(), facet: z.number() }))
  .output(z.object({ sources: z.array(source) }))
  .prompt(input => `Search angle ${input.facet} of 20 for: ${input.question}. Extract claims with source URLs.`)
  .intents(['browse']);

const synthesizerRole = H.role('synthesizer')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string(), sources: z.array(source) }))
  .output(z.object({ report: z.string(), citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .prompt(input => `Write a sourced report answering: ${input.question}\n\nSources:\n${input.sources.map(s => `${s.url}: ${s.claim}`).join('\n')}`);

const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 4 });
const citationCheck = H.command('citation-check')
  .input(z.object({ citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(input => ['check-citations', ...input.citations])
  .on(local);

const citationPassRate = (metrics: Metrics, model: Model) => metrics.rate({
  among: { entry: 'invocation', executable: citationCheck.name, tags: { synthModel: model.name } },
  count: { entry: 'invocation', executable: citationCheck.name, tags: { synthModel: model.name }, ok: true },
  days: 60,
});

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizer-by-citation-pass', choice => {
  const a = citationPassRate(choice.metrics, opus);
  const b = citationPassRate(choice.metrics, sonnet);
  if (a.samples < 15 || b.samples < 15) return a.samples <= b.samples ? opus : sonnet;
  return (a.value ?? 0) >= (b.value ?? 0) ? opus : sonnet;
});

const searcher = H.agent('searcher', searcherRole).model(haiku).recalls(sourceExperience);
const synthesizer = H.agent('synthesizer', synthesizerRole)
  .model(synthesizerModel)
  .recalls(findings, sourceExperience)
  .records(sourceExperience);

const minimumSources = 5;

const researchFlow = H.flow('research')
  .for(Topic)
  .does(async ctx => {
    const { title, question } = ctx.unit.data;
    await ctx.move('researching');
    const searches = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, facet) => ({ question, facet }));
    const results = await ctx.batch(searcher, searches);
    const sources = results.flatMap(result => result.ok ? result.value.sources : []);
    if (sources.length < minimumSources) return 'parked';
    const synthesis = await ctx.run(synthesizer, { question, sources });
    if (!synthesis.ok) return 'failed';
    ctx.tag({ synthModel: synthesis.model ?? 'unknown' });
    const checked = await ctx.run(citationCheck, { citations: synthesis.value.citations });
    if (!checked.ok) return 'failed';
    await ctx.remember(findings, {
      text: `When researching questions like "${question}", start from the conclusions of the "${title}" report`,
      because: synthesis.value.report.slice(0, 500),
      when: { kinds: [Topic.name] },
    });
    return 'delivered';
  });

const reopen = (key: string): TopicSupply => ({ update: key, state: 'queued' });
const terminal = new Set(['succeeded', 'failed', 'ended', 'cancelled']);

const topicLane = H.lane('topics', Topic)
  .handler(researchFlow)
  .suppliers(
    H.operator,
    H.schedule('weekly-recurring', Topic, { weekly: { day: 'mon', at: '06:00' } }, tick =>
      tick.units
        .filter(unit => unit.data.tags.includes('recurring') && terminal.has(unit.outcome))
        .map(unit => reopen(unit.key))),
  )
  .store(sqlite.store(Topic, '.harness/topics.db'))
  .maxUsdPerUnit(3);

const dailyBudgetUsd = 40;
const topicCeilingUsd = 3;

const budgetScheduler = H.policy.schedule('daily-budget', view => {
  const startOfDay = new Date(Date.UTC(view.now.getUTCFullYear(), view.now.getUTCMonth(), view.now.getUTCDate()));
  const spent = view.metrics.sum({ of: 'costUsd', among: { entry: 'invocation' }, since: startOfDay }).value ?? 0;
  const projected = view.metrics.mean({
    of: 'costUsd',
    among: { entry: 'attempt', kind: Topic.name, outcome: 'succeeded' },
    days: 30,
  }).value ?? topicCeilingUsd;
  let remaining = dailyBudgetUsd - spent;
  const start = [...view.pending].sort((a, b) => b.waitedMs - a.waitedMs).filter(() => {
    if (projected > remaining) return false;
    remaining -= projected;
    return true;
  });
  return { start };
});

const pool = H.pool('anthropic', [
  { account: anthropic.account('research-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }), share: 1 },
], H.policy.account('first-eligible', choice => choice.accounts.find(view => view.eligible)?.account ?? null));

export const harness = H.harness('research-pipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.db'))
  .lanes(topicLane)
  .pools(pool)
  .scheduler(budgetScheduler)
  .clients(claudeCode.supervisor({
    grants: [H.ops.readWork, H.ops.writeWork, H.ops.readMemory, H.ops.writeMemory, H.ops.readTelemetry],
  }))
  .observers(markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md'));

const hostA = ssh.host('db-host-a', { address: 'db-a.internal', user: 'ops', key: sshKey, slots: 1, preflight: diskPreflight });
const hostB = ssh.host('db-host-b', { address: 'db-b.internal', user: 'ops', key: sshKey, slots: 1, preflight: diskPreflight });

  if (check.value.daysLeft >= 14) return 'valid';

  const renewal = await ctx.run(renewCertificate, ctx.unit.data);

});

  await ctx.move('remediating');
  const remediation = await ctx.run(runbook, { runbook: ctx.unit.data.runbook });
  await ctx.move('confirming');
  const confirmation = await ctx.halt({
    name: 'confirm-resolution',
    show: remediation.ok ? `Runbook ${ctx.unit.data.runbook} completed.` : `Runbook failed: ${remediation.error}`,
    decision: z.object({ resolved: z.boolean() }),
  });

});

const services = [
  { service: 'api', url: 'https://api.internal/health' },
  { service: 'queue', url: 'https://queue.internal/health' },
];
const databases = [
  { database: 'orders', host: hostA.name },
  { database: 'users', host: hostB.name },
];
const domains = [
  { domain: 'example.com', host: hostA.name },
  { domain: 'api.example.com', host: hostB.name },
];
const dayOf = (date: Date) => date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const heartbeatLane = H.lane('heartbeats', Heartbeat)
  .handler(heartbeatFlow)
  .suppliers(H.schedule('every-five-minutes', Heartbeat, { every: { minutes: 5 } }, tick =>
    services.map(service => ({ create: service, key: `${service.service}-${tick.now.toISOString()}` }))));

const backupLane = H.lane('backups', Backup)
  .handler(backupFlow)
  .suppliers(H.schedule('nightly', Backup, { daily: '01:00' }, tick =>

    title: `${event.unit.data.service} is down`,
    detail: `Three consecutive heartbeats failed against ${event.unit.data.url}.`,
    runbook: `restart-${event.unit.data.service}`,
  }),
);

const failedBackup = H.trigger('failed-backup', H.on.enters(Backup, 'failed'), (event, act) =>
  act.create(incidentLane, {
    title: `Backup of ${event.unit.data.database} failed`,
    detail: `Backup unit ${event.unit.key} on ${event.unit.data.host} failed.`,
    runbook: `verify-backup-${event.unit.data.database}`,

  const start = [...view.pending]
    .filter(unit => !(incidentActive && unit.is(Backup)))

});

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as jsonl from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import * as ssh from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const NightlyLoad = H.kind('NightlyLoad').data(z.object({
  source: z.string(),
  night: z.string(),
})).states({
  queued: 'pending',
  extracting: 'active',
  validating: 'active',
  summarizing: 'active',
  'awaiting-approval': 'active',
  loading: 'active',
  verifying: 'active',
  loaded: 'succeeded',
  'loaded-with-warnings': 'succeeded',
  rejected: 'ended',
  failed: 'failed',
  expired: 'cancelled',
}, 'queued');

const Taste = H.memory('approver-taste', 'owner');
const taste = H.library('approver-taste', Taste, jsonl.memory('memory/taste.jsonl'));

const warehouse = ssh.host('warehouse', {
  address: 'warehouse.internal',
  user: 'etl',
  key: H.env('ETL_SSH_KEY'),
  slots: 2,
});
const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 2 });

const job = z.object({ source: z.string(), night: z.string() });

const extract = H.command('extract').input(job).argv(input => ['etl', 'extract', input.source, input.night]).on(warehouse);
const validate = H.command('validate').input(job).argv(input => ['etl', 'validate', input.source, input.night]).on(local);
const load = H.command('load').input(job).argv(input => ['etl', 'load', input.source, input.night]).on(warehouse);
const verify = H.command('verify')
  .input(job)
  .output(z.object({ driftPercent: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['etl', 'verify', '--json', input.source, input.night])
  .on(warehouse);

const exponentialBackoff = H.policy.retry('three-retries-exponential', view =>
  view.failures > 3 ? 'stop' : { retryInMs: 30_000 * 2 ** (view.failures - 1) });

const summaryRole = H.role('anomaly-summary')
  .input(z.object({ source: z.string(), night: z.string(), report: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }))
  .prompt(input => `Summarise in plain language the anomalies in the ${input.source} load for ${input.night}:\n\n${input.report}`);

const summarizer = H.agent('anomaly-summarizer', summaryRole)
  .model(anthropic.model('claude-sonnet'))
  .recalls(taste);

const tolerableDriftPercent = 0.5;

const nightlyFlow = H.flow('nightly-load').for(NightlyLoad).does(async ctx => {
  const input = ctx.unit.data;
  await ctx.move('extracting');
  const extracted = await ctx.run(extract, input, { retry: exponentialBackoff });
  if (!extracted.ok) return 'failed';
  await ctx.move('validating');
  const validated = await ctx.run(validate, input);
  let report = validated.ok ? validated.value : validated.error;
  if (!validated.ok) {
    const review = await ctx.halt({
      name: 'validation-failed',
      show: validated.error,
      decision: z.object({ proceed: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }),
    });
    if (!review.proceed) return 'rejected';
    report = `${report}\n\nReviewer note: ${review.note ?? ''}`;
  }
  await ctx.move('summarizing');
  const summary = await ctx.run(summarizer, { ...input, report });
  await ctx.move('awaiting-approval');
  const approval = await ctx.halt({
    name: 'approve-load',
    show: summary.ok ? summary.value.summary : report,

  submitted: 'pending',
  reviewing: 'active',
  'with-editor': 'active',
  accepted: 'succeeded',
  returned: 'idle',
  failed: 'failed',
  withdrawn: 'cancelled',
}, 'submitted');

type DraftSupply = Supply<DataOf<typeof Draft>, StateOf<typeof Draft>>;

const Taste = H.memory('editorial-taste', 'owner');
const Experience = H.memory('fact-checking', 'fallible');
const taste = H.library('editorial-taste', Taste, jsonl.memory('memory/taste.jsonl'));
const experience = H.library('fact-checking', Experience, jsonl.memory('memory/fact-checking.jsonl'));

const sonnet = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet');
const haiku = anthropic.model('claude-haiku');

const actedOnRate = (metrics: Metrics, seat: 'A' | 'B', model: Model) => {
  const among = { entry: 'halt' as const, halt: 'editor', status: 'resolved', tags: { [`model${seat}`]: model.name } };
  return metrics.rate({ among, count: { ...among, decision: { [`actedOn${seat}`]: true } } });
};

const reviewerModel = (seat: 'A' | 'B', incumbent: Model, rival: Model, challenger: Model) =>
  H.policy.model(`reviewer-${seat}-model`, choice => {
    const mine = actedOnRate(choice.metrics, seat, incumbent);
    const theirs = actedOnRate(choice.metrics, seat === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A', rival);
    const decided = mine.samples >= 50 && theirs.samples >= 50;
    return decided && (mine.value ?? 0) < (theirs.value ?? 0) ? challenger : incumbent;
  });

  .input(z.object({ title: z.string(), section: z.string(), body: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ critique: z.string() }))
  .prompt(input => `Critique this ${input.section} draft, "${input.title}":\n\n${input.body}`);

const reviewerA = H.agent('reviewer-a', reviewerRole).model(reviewerModel('A', opus, sonnet, haiku)).recalls(taste, experience);
const reviewerB = H.agent('reviewer-b', reviewerRole).model(reviewerModel('B', sonnet, opus, haiku)).recalls(taste, experience);

  .input(z.object({ a: z.string(), b: z.string() }))

  .input(z.object({ draftId: z.string(), body: z.string() }))

})).states({
  scheduled: 'pending',
  measuring: 'active',
  waiting: 'idle',

  'b-wins': 'ended',
  inconclusive: 'ended',
  cancelled: 'cancelled',
}, 'scheduled');

const measure = H.command('measure-experiment')
  .input(z.object({ name: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ a: z.number(), b: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['experiment-metric', '--json', input.name])
  .on(local);

  await ctx.move('measuring');
  const now = ctx.now();
  const sample = await ctx.run(measure, { name: ctx.unit.data.name });
  const observations = sample.ok
    ? [...ctx.unit.data.observations, { at: now.toISOString(), a: sample.value.a, b: sample.value.b }]
    : ctx.unit.data.observations;
  await ctx.update({ observations });
  if (now.getTime() - Date.parse(ctx.unit.data.startedAt) < 14 * dayMs) {
    return ctx.until('waiting', { at: new Date(now.getTime() + hourMs), then: 'scheduled' });
  }
  const a = mean(observations.map(o => o.a));
  const b = mean(observations.map(o => o.b));
  const lift = Math.abs(a - b) / Math.max(Math.abs(a), Math.abs(b), Number.EPSILON);

  }
  const sent = await ctx.run(sendToVendor, { vendor, message: proposal.value.message });
  if (!sent.ok) return 'vendor-replied';
  if (proposal.value.move === 'accept') return 'agreed';
  await ctx.update({ lastOffer: proposal.value.message, round: ctx.unit.data.round + 1 });
  return 'awaiting-vendor';
});

const vendorReply = z.object({
  negotiationId: z.string(),
  outcome: z.enum(['counter', 'accept', 'walk-away']),
  message: z.string(),
});

const negotiationLane = H.lane('negotiations', Negotiation)
  .handler(negotiationFlow)
  .suppliers(
    H.operator,
    http.webhook(Negotiation, {
      path: '/hooks/vendor-replies',
      secret: H.env('VENDOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
      body: vendorReply,
      read: body => ({
        update: body.negotiationId,
        patch: { vendorMessage: body.message },
        state: body.outcome === 'counter' ? 'vendor-replied' : body.outcome === 'accept' ? 'agreed' : 'walked-away-them',
      }),
    }),
  )
  .store(sqlite.store(Negotiation, '.harness/negotiations.db'));

const negotiationExpiry = H.trigger(
  'negotiation-expiry',
  H.on.deadline(Negotiation, data => new Date(data.expiresAt), ['opening', 'vendor-replied', 'drafting', 'awaiting-vendor']),
  (_event, act) => act.move('expired'),
);

const experimentsWorthRunning = H.policy.schedule('experiments-worth-running', view => {
  const inconclusive = view.metrics.rate({
    among: { entry: 'transition', kind: Experiment.name, outcome: ['succeeded', 'failed', 'ended'] },
    count: { entry: 'transition', kind: Experiment.name, state: 'inconclusive' },
    days: 180,
  });
  const holdNewExperiments = inconclusive.samples >= 10 && (inconclusive.value ?? 0) > 0.6;
  const start = [...view.pending]
    .filter(unit => !(holdNewExperiments && unit.is(Experiment) && unit.state === 'scheduled' && unit.data.observations.length === 0))
    .sort((a, b) => b.waitedMs - a.waitedMs);
  return { start };
});

const pool = H.pool('anthropic', [
  { account: anthropic.account('business-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }), share: 1 },
], H.policy.account('first-eligible', choice => choice.accounts.find(view => view.eligible)?.account ?? null));

export const harness = H.harness('long-lived-work')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.db'))
  .lanes(experimentLane, tenancyLane, negotiationLane)
  .pools(pool)
  .triggers(negotiationExpiry)
  .scheduler(experimentsWorthRunning)
  .clients(claudeCode.supervisor({
    grants: [H.ops.readWork, H.ops.writeWork, H.ops.resolveHalts, H.ops.readTelemetry],
  }))
  .observers(markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md'));
